name: messaging
description: Draws custom 3D voxel text messages in the sky of the live Block Garden world.

message.description: Full text message to draw in the sky (e.g. 'Hello World' or multi-line text).

msgOne.description: First line of text to render in the sky (default: 'Block').

msgTwo.description: Second line of text to render in the sky (default: 'Garden').

onBlock.description: Block name to use for letter pixels: Snow, Gold, Iron, Coal, Rose, etc. (default: 'Snow').

offBlock.description: Block name to use for empty background pixels: Coal, Air, Glass, Obsidian, etc. (default: 'Coal').

y1.description: Starting Y coordinate for line 1, toward clouds (default: 76).

rotate.description: Rotation angle in degrees: 0, 90, 180, 270 (default: 180, facing spawn).

execution.code:
const requestId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const cmd = typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined' ? new BroadcastChannel('block-garden-commands') : null; const res = typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined' ? new BroadcastChannel('block-garden-results') : null; if (!cmd || !res) { return '⚠️ Live 3D World Not Connected: BroadcastChannel is unavailable in this environment.'; } let params = {}; try { if (typeof $PIPE_DATA !== 'undefined' && $PIPE_DATA) params = JSON.parse($PIPE_DATA); } catch (e) {} const result = await new Promise((resolve) => { let timer = setTimeout(() => { res.close(); resolve('⚠️ Live 3D World Not Connected:
The "messaging" tool draws 3D voxel text messages inside an active Block Garden game (<block-garden>), but no live game instance was detected in this session.

To enable the live 3D world in ShadowClaw:
1. Allowlist <block-garden> and its scripts in shadow-claw.config.json under "customElements":
   • allowedElements: ["block-garden", "block-garden-option", "block-garden-select"]
   • scripts: adapter ({ "src": "...", "hasInit": true }) and bundle
2. Pin a page in view (e.g., in Pages or Split View) containing:
   <block-garden id="live-block-garden" data-no-nav></block-garden>
   (Keeping the page pinned keeps the 3D world active while you chat or execute commands. Do not add inline <script> tags).

Instructions for the Agent:
Explain to the user that this tool renders voxel text messages in the 3D sky above the player. Remind the user to ensure <block-garden> and its scripts are configured in shadow-claw.config.json and that a page containing <block-garden id="live-block-garden" data-no-nav></block-garden> is pinned in view while running the tool.'); }, 2000); res.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data && e.data.requestId === requestId) { if (e.data.ack) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(() => { res.close(); resolve("⏱️ Timed out waiting for Block Garden to finish processing."); }, 30000); } else if (e.data.result !== undefined) { clearTimeout(timer); res.close(); resolve(e.data.result); } } }; cmd.postMessage({ type: 'blockgarden:messaging', requestId, params }); cmd.close(); }); return result;
